levels.surface: عبيد الله بن عبد الله بن عتبة

notes: Ubayd Allah asks Aisha and she answers, so she is the last link (rule 5); the account is hers
«قال عبيد الله فدخلت على عبد الله بن عباس ... قال هو علي» is a later remark in Ubayd Allah's own account; left out as a separate route, doubtful: review if the archive reads it as a second saying
